outline: Introduction to AI's impact on the professional landscape.
Differentiating between AI automation and AI augmentation.
Exploring new job roles created by AI.
Strategies for effectively discussing AI skills in career contexts.
prerequisites: To follow this tutorial, you should have a basic understanding of what Artificial Intelligence is.

slides.title: Slide 1: Title Slide: AI in the Professional Landscape
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **AI** in the Professional Landscape.

slides.title: Slide 2: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
First, you will learn about **AI** automation. You will also learn about **AI** augmentation.
Next, you will identify new job roles emerging due to **AI**.
Finally, you will learn to communicate **AI** skills effectively.
This applies to resumes and interviews.

slides.title: Slide 3: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Slide 4: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
A basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence is needed for this tutorial.
No prior coding knowledge is needed.

slides.title: Slide 5: AI's Impact
slides.narration:
**AI** is not just a tool for fun.
It is a major force changing the professional landscape.
It is reshaping how we work and the types of jobs available.

slides.title: Slide 6: Automating vs. Augmenting Tasks
slides.narration:
It is crucial to understand the difference between automation and augmentation.
This is important when discussing **AI**.

slides.title: Slide 7: Automation
slides.narration:
Automation is when **AI** takes over a repetitive task completely.
For example, an **AI** system can automatically sort customer support emails.
It categorizes them into groups like "Billing" or "Technical Issue".
This saves human effort on mundane tasks.

slides.title: Slide 8: Augmentation
slides.narration:
Augmentation is when **AI** acts as a partner to help a human do their job.
This makes their work better or faster.
This is where the biggest immediate impact is.
Think of **AI** as a co-pilot, not just an autopilot.

slides.title: Slide 9: Augmentation Example
slides.narration:
A marketing professional uses **AI** to brainstorm 20 different headlines.
This is for an ad campaign and can be done in seconds.
This allows them to focus their time on choosing and refining the best one.
Notice how **AI** enhances human creativity and efficiency.

slides.title: Slide 10: The Rise of New Job Roles
slides.narration:
**AI** isn't just about changing old jobs.
It is creating entirely new ones.
Let's look at some of these emerging roles.

slides.title: Slide 11: Prompt Engineer
slides.narration:
A **Prompt Engineer** is an expert who specializes in crafting the perfect prompts.
These **prompts** are designed to get the most accurate and high-quality results.
This is from **AI** models.
This role requires understanding how **AI** thinks and responds.

slides.title: Slide 12: AI Auditor
slides.narration:
An **AI Auditor** is a professional who tests and reviews **AI** systems.
They check for bias, ethical issues, and safety risks.
This is done before these systems are released to the public.
This ensures fairness and reliability in **AI** applications.

slides.title: Slide 13: AI Content Manager
slides.narration:
An **AI Content Manager** oversees the use of **AI** in content creation.
They ensure **AI**-generated first drafts are fact-checked, edited, and refined.
This is done to meet quality standards.
This role combines human oversight with **AI** efficiency.

slides.title: Slide 14: How to Talk About AI Skills
slides.narration:
Simply listing **ChatGPT** on your resume isn't enough.
You need to show how you use **AI** to create value.
Let's see how to do this effectively.

slides.title: Slide 15: On Your Resume
slides.narration:
On your resume, focus on results.
Instead of writing, "Proficient in **AI** tools," consider a more descriptive approach.
For example, write: "Utilized **Google Gemini** to summarize research reports."
This reduced content analysis time by 40%.
Notice the specific tool and the measurable outcome.

slides.title: Slide 16: In an Interview
slides.narration:
In an interview, frame **AI** as a productivity tool that enhances your skills.
You could say, "I see **AI** as a powerful assistant."
I use it to handle first drafts and brainstorm ideas.
This frees me up to spend more time on higher-level strategic thinking.
It also allows for more time on editing and creative problem-solving.
This shows you leverage **AI** for higher value tasks.

slides.title: Slide 17: Summary Slide
slides.narration:
Let's summarize.
In this tutorial, we learned the difference between **AI** automation and augmentation.
We also learned about new job roles like **Prompt Engineer** and **AI Auditor**.
Finally, we covered how to effectively communicate **AI** skills.
This applies to resumes and in interviews.

slides.title: Slide 18: Assignment Slide
slides.narration:
Now, let's do a small activity.
Think of a task in your current or desired profession.
First, describe how **AI** could automate a part of it.
Then, describe how **AI** could augment your role in that task.
Finally, write a sentence for your resume.
This should highlight your **AI** skill in this context.
